entries.title: Psalms 150:1
segments: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise God in his sanctuary: Praise him in the firmament of his power.

entries.title: Psalms 150:2
segments: Praise him for his mighty acts: Praise him according to his excellent greatness.

entries.title: Psalms 150:3
segments: Praise him with trumpet sound: Praise him with psaltery and harp.

entries.title: Psalms 150:4
segments: Praise him with timbrel and dance: Praise him with stringed instruments and pipe.

entries.title: Psalms 150:5
segments: Praise him with loud cymbals: Praise him with high sounding cymbals.

entries.title: Psalms 150:6
segments: Let everything that hath breath praise Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah.
